products.name: Vidu (Tsinghua / Shengshu)
products.note: Video generation model; academic spin-off; cross-border data review advised

profile_text.body:
Shengshu Technology operates Vidu, an AI video generation platform accessible at vidu.studio. The company describes Vidu as a tool that transforms text prompts, static images, and reference videos into generated video content, supporting three primary creation modes: Text to Video, Image to Video, and Reference to Video. The site presents Vidu as suited to independent creators as well as teams, with stated applications spanning social media content, 2D animation, artistic styles, and commercial advertising, including use cases such as animating product images and altering advertisement backgrounds.

Vidu is noted in the site's held facts as an academic spin-off connected to Tsinghua University, and the held facts include an advisory that cross-border data review is recommended for users considering the platform. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
